source_title: The False God And The Birth Of Evil
summary: This Secret History lecture is a high-pressure monotheism and secret-society origin source: Jiang models religion as a sequence from mother-goddess fertility to polytheistic war memory to imperial monotheism, then uses the false-God, inner-light, and Paradise Lost reversals to explain why secret societies begin as a noble mission before corrupting.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public Power page already cites this source for the modern abstraction hinge: one true God creates truth, evil, and the individual, letting a person step outside family and community under a higher abstraction.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Power As Alchemy owns the abstraction-to-reality conversion, and this source is already represented in the Monotheism And Modern Abstraction section. No episode-link repair is needed in this compact intake.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: preserve this source as the developed 2025-09-05 branch after the first Power lecture. It clarifies how monotheism turns the singular God into truth, evil, and the individual, with modernity later inheriting those abstractions.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns the abstraction engine. Religion owns office-centered filtering; Eschatology owns role-script endings; Free Will owns the inner-light agency burden; Secret Society owns coordination and preservation of hidden doctrine.

new_lens_seeds.title: Monotheism As Abstraction Engine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Empire makes one reality enforceable; one true God then creates truth, evil, and the individual, allowing modern abstractions to detach people from local family/community while also making them legible to larger institutions.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source supplies the strongest branch so far for the held seed after Power Is Alchemy and Godhead Equation: monotheism is not only symbol-to-reality conversion but a restructuring of personhood, evil, and truth under empire.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Keep held. This is stronger promotion pressure, but later Secret History Judaism/Christianity/Islam, Paul, and modern reason sources still need comparison before public promotion.

new_lens_seeds.title: False God And Inner Light
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: The worshipped external God is recast as a false God or Demiurge while the true God remains as inner light, making knowledge, mistake, transgression, self-belief, and redemption inward rather than institutionally administered.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism may become a Free Will, Dead World, or Eschatology child only if later Secret History and Great Books sources show that inner-light agency needs a narrower public hover than existing pages provide.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create standalone False God, Demiurge, Inner Light, Gnosticism, Satan, Paradise Lost, or Nephilim pages from this source alone.
